summary: Two lanes on: admit (memory reserve, five-hour window, once-per-kind waiting note), a port per lane (port_alloc_ under the record and port locks), a merge lock, lanes-end + exit 16, atomic rec_count, USAGE_5H, sliced limit/mem waits, TEST_FILE_TIMEOUT. Clamp gone. Tests 555 -> 566.
verified_how: check.sh: green in 414 s, 566 tests. 47-lanes-two 11/11 (two lanes at once, ports 7950/7951 and in prompts, both merged, done; memory wait noted once then opens on fixture swap; 5-hour 80% wait noted once; session cap -> other lane 'the run is ending'; stop in a limit wait ends within a slice). 33: TEST_FILE_TIMEOUT=2s file -> one FAIL line, under 20 s. The new checks ran red first (47 aborted, 33 timeout FAIL). bash -n all shell files, node --check lib/metrics.mjs. Opus review: 1 Important + 6 Minor, all fixed.

discoveries.text: Concurrent git writers in one repo: .git/config fails instead of waiting (fixed for lanes: --no-track, no -u). P2-04's branch deletion at merge (branch -D writes config) must run while other lanes push; check it under two lanes.
merge_one's fetch of main can collide with another lane's sync_main fetch (ref lock); it now retries once and logs, and merges on the next reap.

Suite wall time 414 s at TEST_JOBS=4 (was ~256 s before P2-02); 47-lanes-two is ~110 s of slot time (its limit-wait check sleeps one 60 s slice). Measured, not a gate. The first full run here had 5 failures in 08, 13 and 32 that passed on rerun alone and in the next full run (load flakes, not reproduced).
admit lives in lib/scope.sh (beside mem_available_gb) so it is unit-checkable; port_taken moved from bin/harness to lib/config.sh; both runs and lanes allocate under $STATE_ROOT/port.lock.
stub hold-coding now also touches held-<run>-<id> and releases on release-<run>-<id>: a check can choose which lane goes first.
